title: Remote host: the mac as a second screen of the laptop's session
notes: Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-28-remote-host-design.md. The laptop app listens on a websocket; the mac app connects from the Ctrl+S picker and relays the bridge. One session, two screens.
